# 接口清单

## envelope.ts

| 类型 | 字段 |
|---|---|
| SpecEnvelope | id, type, goal, inputs, **accept**, budget, tools, reply |
| ResultEnvelope | id, status, summary, refs, checks, children, spent |
| EventRecord | ts, kind, data |

## runs.ts

- `createRun` / `writeSpec` / `writeResult` / `appendEvent`
- `pendingNodes`：有 spec 无 result = 待拉起

> 备注：事件 kind 含 `tool_call` `tool_result` `message` `spawn` `exit` `gate`。
